source.english_context: Unit 20 Gas Stations, Parking, and Car Problems Goal: buy gas, understand parking signs, and explain simple car trouble. Daily Life English Which pump should I use? Can I pay inside? My tire is flat. Is parking allowed here? I would like thirty dollars of regular gas. Could I have a receipt for pump four? Where can I put air in my tires? My car will not start. Can you call a tow truck? How long can I park in this space? What time does the parking meter stop charging? Is there a parking garage nearby? The warning light came on while I was driving. Can you check the tire pressure? How much will the repair cost? Vocabulary gas pump the machine used to put gas in a car regular gas the common, lower-cost type of gasoline flat tire a tire without enough air tow truck a truck that moves a broken car parking meter a machine or app for paid street parking ticket a fine for breaking a parking rule tire pressure the amount of air pressure inside a tire roadside assistance a service that helps drivers with car problems on the road parking garage a building where you can park a car warning light a light on a car's dashboard that shows a possible problem engine the part of a car that produces power to move it repair estimate an expected price for fixing a problem US Customs Read parking signs carefully. Rules may change by time, day, and side of the street. Some gas pumps ask for a ZIP code when you pay by card. If the car has a serious problem, move to a safe place before calling for help. When paying inside a gas station, tell the cashier your pump number and the amount or fuel type you want. Ask whether a parking space has a time limit before leaving your car. Check nearby signs as well as the meter. When arranging a repair, describe the problem and when it happens. Ask for an estimate before agreeing to the work. Keep your parking or repair receipt until you have checked the details. Ask whom to contact if a charge is unclear. Dialogue Student: Excuse me, can I pay for gas inside? Cashier: Yes. Which pump are you using? Student: Pump 4, please. I need $30 of regular gas. Cashier: Okay. You can start pumping now. Student: Thank you. Can I get a receipt when I finish? Cashier: Yes. Come back and tell me your pump number. Student: Is there a place here to check my tire pressure? Cashier: The air machine is beside the car wash. Student: Does it take coins or a card? Cashier: It takes a card. The instructions are on the front.

japanese_explanation.heading: 車では表示を読む力が必要
points: 駐車標識は時間、曜日、場所によって変わります。短い文でも、No parking や permit only は必ず確認しましょう。
ガソリンスタンドではカードで払う時にZIPコードを求められることがあります。うまくいかない時は店内で払えます。
車のトラブルでは、まず安全な場所に移動します。その後、保険会社、ロードサービス、修理店に連絡します。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 开车生活需要会看标志
points: 停车标志会根据时间、日期和地点变化。即使英文短，也要注意 No parking 和 permit only。
加油站刷卡时，有时会要求输入ZIP code。如果机器不成功，可以进店付款。
车出问题时，先把车移到安全地方，然后联系保险、道路救援或修车店。

points: 駐車標識は時間、曜日、場所によって変わります。短い文でも、"No parking" や "permit only" は必ず確認しましょう。
ガソリンスタンドではカードで払う時にZIPコードを求められることがあります。うまくいかない時は店内で払えます。
車のトラブルでは、まず安全な場所に移動します。その後、保険会社、ロードサービス、修理店に連絡します。

ko.heading: 차량 이용 시 표지판 해독 능력의 중요성
points: 주차 표지판은 시간, 요일, 장소에 따라 달라집니다. 짧은 문구라도 "No parking" 또는 "permit only"는 반드시 확인하세요.
주유소에서 카드로 결제할 때 우편번호(ZIP 코드)를 요구할 수 있습니다. 기기에서 결제가 되지 않을 경우 매장 안에서 결제할 수 있습니다.
차량에 문제가 생겼을 때는 먼저 안전한 장소로 이동하세요. 그 다음 보험사, 긴급출동 서비스, 또는 정비소에 연락하십시오.

zh-Hans.heading: 开车生活需要会看标志
points: 停车标志会根据时间、日期和地点变化。即使英文短，也要注意 "No parking" 和 "permit only"。
加油站刷卡时，有时会要求输入ZIP code。如果机器不成功，可以进店付款。
车出问题时，先把车移到安全地方，然后联系保险、道路救援或修车店。

es.heading: Es esencial saber leer las señales al conducir
points: Las señales de estacionamiento cambian según la hora, el día y el lugar. Incluso con frases cortas como "No parking" o "permit only", asegúrese de revisarlas siempre.
En las gasolineras, es posible que le pidan un código postal (ZIP code) al pagar con tarjeta. Si no funciona, puede pagar dentro de la tienda.
Si tiene problemas con el coche, primero muévase a un lugar seguro. Después, contacte a su compañía de seguros, a la asistencia en carretera o a un taller de reparación.

pt-BR.heading: A capacidade de ler placas é essencial ao dirigir
points: As placas de estacionamento mudam de acordo com o horário, o dia e o local. Mesmo com frases curtas como "No parking" ou "permit only", certifique-se de sempre verificá-las.
Em postos de gasolina, podem pedir um código postal (ZIP code) ao pagar com cartão. Se não funcionar, você pode pagar dentro da loja.
Em caso de problemas com o carro, primeiro mova-se para um local seguro. Depois, entre em contato com sua seguradora, assistência na estrada ou oficina mecânica.

fr.heading: Savoir lire les panneaux est essentiel en voiture
points: Les panneaux de stationnement peuvent varier selon l'heure, le jour et l'endroit. Même pour des phrases courtes comme "No parking" ou "permit only", assurez-vous de toujours les vérifier.
Dans les stations-service, un code postal (ZIP code) peut vous être demandé lors du paiement par carte. Si cela ne fonctionne pas, vous pouvez payer à l'intérieur du magasin.
En cas de problème avec votre voiture, déplacez-vous d'abord vers un endroit sûr. Ensuite, contactez votre compagnie d'assurance, l'assistance routière ou un garage de réparation.

de.heading: Die Fähigkeit, Schilder zu lesen, ist beim Autofahren unerlässlich
points: Parkschilder können je nach Uhrzeit, Tag und Ort variieren. Achten Sie auch bei kurzen Formulierungen wie "No parking" oder "permit only" immer darauf, diese zu überprüfen.
An Tankstellen werden Sie möglicherweise nach einer Postleitzahl (ZIP code) gefragt, wenn Sie mit Karte bezahlen. Sollte es nicht funktionieren, können Sie im Laden bezahlen.
Bei Autopannen fahren Sie zuerst an einen sicheren Ort. Danach kontaktieren Sie Ihre Versicherungsgesellschaft, den Pannendienst oder eine Reparaturwerkstatt.
